about_the_game:
SPARTACUS BLOOD ARENA -  ALPHA VERSION

Join our Discord : 👉

Step into the Sand of History – Spartacus: Blood Arena (pitch)

Enter the brutal and thrilling world of ancient gladiatorial combat in Spartacus: Blood Arena, a game developed in close partnership with archaeologists and historical reenactors. This unique collaboration brings unmatched authenticity to every weapon clash, armor detail, and arena roar. Immerse yourself in a faithful recreation of Roman gladiator life, where honor, blood, and survival collide under the watchful gaze of history.

Alpha Release – What’s Included

This Alpha version of Spartacus Blood Arena offers early access to a work-in-progress build focused on gathering community feedback and refining core gameplay systems.

Included in this Alpha:

  • 6 playable environments: Distinct settings where you can test the arena combat experience.

  • 3 gladiator characters, each available with or without helmets, providing visual variety.

  • An early version of our combat system, featuring directional attacks, defense mechanics, and finishing moves (in development, subject to updates).

  • Online multiplayer (PvP): Fight against other players in optimized 1v1 battles.

  • Local play (1v1 or vs AI): Test your skills offline in solo or local duels.

This is just the beginning — a crucial first step for us. Your constructive feedback will be essential in helping us refine and improve the entire project.

🔄 As development continues, we’ll be rolling out regular patches and updates on the road to the Beta version.
📖 The Story Mode will be developed in a later phase, once we’ve solidified the core gameplay experience.

Your input is extremely valuable at this stage. Please share your thoughts to help shape the future of Spartacus Blood Arena.

Spartacus Blood Arena / Game Concept :

Battle to the Last Blood – Enter the Arena of Legends

In an age where steel spoke louder than words and the roar of the crowd decided your fate, only the strongest could rise above the bloodstained sands.

Welcome to Battle to the Last Blood, where history and myth collide in a brutal dance of survival. Step into the sandals of legendary warriors—gladiators, champions, and rebels—each with a story etched in scars and fire. From the echoing halls of Roman arenas to forgotten battlefields lost to time, fight with honor or die in shame.

Forged in collaboration with real historians and expert reenactors, every duel pulses with authenticity. The clang of iron, the cries of the crowd, the weight of a gladius in your hand—it’s not just a game, it’s a resurrection of ancient glory.

Will you earn your freedom... or fall forgotten in the dust?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1060 (VRAM 6GB) / Radeon RX 580 (VRAM 4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo / 5.1
  • VR Support: no

short_description: Battle to the Last Blood is a visceral historical fighting game that throws you into the heart of ancient gladiatorial combat. Crafted with archaeologists and reenactors, it delivers brutal, authentic battles where every strike could be your last. Fight for glory, honor, and survival.
